## Summary

I've successfully added a `currency` setting to the `Config` class with a default value of `"USD"`. 

**What was done:**
- Added `currency: str = "USD"` as a new field to the frozen dataclass `Config`
- The existing `load()` function automatically supports the new setting since it uses `fields(Config)` to determine valid configuration keys

**Why this approach:**
- Follows the pattern of existing settings (`db_path`, `rates_url`)
- Respects the active decision (doc://ledger/config-file-only@0001) which specifies config comes from `ledger.toml` only
- Requires zero changes to the `load()` function—it dynamically discovers fields via the dataclass `fields()` API
- Users can now override the default by adding `currency = "EUR"` (or any code) to their `ledger.toml` file
